purpose: Refuse detected Windows reparse points during Win64 FLTK source archive creation.
change: The creator checks the selected root attributes and refuses enumerated children with FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT. This prevents detected junction/symlink traversal and cycles.
scope_limits: The Wine regression exercises ordinary Unicode source creation, not reparse-point refusal.
No runtime reparse-point fixture has verified the refusal yet.
A reparse-point substitution between the attribute check and file open remains a Windows source check/use race.
